metadata.description: Supplemental municipal-published Environics 2022 estimates. These values are not 2021 Census counts and must not be used as denominators for 2021 visible-minority counts. No income median is present.
metadata.license: No separate licence statement in ArcGIS item or layer metadata; the public City of Brampton service contains third-party Environics estimates. Do not assume Statistics Canada Open Licence covers these estimates.
metadata.idField: OBJECTID of current brampton-neighbourhoods.geojson, joined to source by NEIGHBOURHOOD_NAME

boundaryMatch.method: Each source/current polygon repaired using Shapely make_valid, projected to EPSG:26917; symmetric difference divided by union area.
boundaryMatch.matchInterpretation: Identical named coverage to numerical export precision; 0 strict-coordinate-identical geometries, all area differences below 0.000006%.

recordDefaults.sourceName: City of Brampton GeoHub neighbourhood profiles — Environics Analytics 2022 population
recordDefaults.caveat: 人口为Brampton市政府发布的Environics Analytics 2022年估算，不是2021年普查人数，也不用于2021年族裔比例分母。收入和族裔分类请查看上方相交统计区的原始普查资料。
recordDefaults.caveatEn: Population is an Environics Analytics 2022 estimate published by the City of Brampton, not a 2021 Census count or a denominator for 2021 population groups. See the overlapping census areas above for income and population categories.
